# 寻求恰在律所不变、满足其目标的状态静止：“比现在更多”需要开放的世界，“高于一切他者”不同时满足两个；不断上升需要不衰减的步，衰减不断则上升停止 / Seeking rests exactly at a state the law leaves unchanged that meets its target: more than now needs an open world and above all others never holds of two; rising without end needs steps that do not run down, and running down stops it

## 主张 Claim

在确定的律 next 之下，从 s 出发的轨道从某步起带着满足的目标静止，恰当它到达一个 next 不变、满足目标的状态（Law.rests_iff）；在这样的状态满足的目标此后每步都满足（Law.fixed_rests）。“比现在更多”，即自身的一个量 q 跨过一步上升（MoreThanNow），只由变化满足（more_not_at_rest、Law.more_never_rests）；每步都满足时任意两个较晚的步之间 q 都上升（more_rises），所以每个配置都是新的（more_new），没有列表容纳它们（more_needs_open，unlisted_of_new 的实例）；往上数满足它（succ_more）。“高于一切他者”，即其他每个寻求者的量都低于自己的（AboveAll），在一个状态至多被一个寻求者满足（aboveAll_unique、aboveAll_not_two），所以在任何律之下，没有律所不变的状态对两个寻求者都满足它（Law.aboveAll_never_rests）。所立者每步被列出（Web.StandingCensus）时，在任意晚处上升的条件，需要在任意晚处有所立者不衰减的步（Flow.more_needs_unrun，由 Flow.change_recurs_iff）；所立者从某步起每步衰减时，没有条件在任意晚处上升（Flow.more_exhausted）。不用 Lean 公理。 / Under a determined law next, the orbit from s comes to rest with its target met from some step on exactly when it reaches a state next leaves unchanged that meets the target (Law.rests_iff); a target met at such a state is met at every later step (Law.fixed_rests). More than now, a quantity q of one's own rising across the step (MoreThanNow), is met only by change (more_not_at_rest, Law.more_never_rests); met at every step, q rises between any two later steps (more_rises), so every configuration is new (more_new) and no list holds them (more_needs_open, an instance of unlisted_of_new); counting on meets it (succ_more). Above all others, every other seeker's quantity below one's own (AboveAll), is met at a state by at most one seeker (aboveAll_unique, aboveAll_not_two), so under any law no state left unchanged meets it for two seekers (Law.aboveAll_never_rests). Where what stands is listed at each step (Web.StandingCensus), a condition rising at arbitrarily late steps needs, at arbitrarily late steps, steps across which what stands does not run down (Flow.more_needs_unrun, from Flow.change_recurs_iff); where what stands runs down at every step from some step on, no condition rises at arbitrarily late steps (Flow.more_exhausted). No Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Seeking.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Seeking.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 目标是配置上的任一条件；目标怎样形成没有建模。rests_iff 设律确定；B2 设所立者每步被列出，这是写在定理中的局部条件。 / A target is any condition on the configuration; how a target forms is not modelled. rests_iff assumes a determined law; B2 assumes what stands is listed at each step, a local condition written into the theorems.
- 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的量。 / Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number quantities.

Ren 10 月 10 日：“the seeking system got locked in, what they are pursuing is illusion(in south asia and Buddhism)”，“find the boundary condition for 无明”；10 月 11 日：“yes let's do 无明”。无明边界计划的 B1（够）与 B2（扩张或耗尽）在这里陈述；B3（反馈）与 B4（明）是 P49、P53、P55 的定理读到寻求上，不重述；B5（劫持）没有陈述。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：无明是使寻求锁定在不能于静止中满足之目标上的不见，其边界是 B1；明是识及支持所不标记者的识；知足、知止是边界之内的目标；支配本身不在所排除者之内。见整合文档 §83。 / Ren on 10 October: “the seeking system got locked in, what they are pursuing is illusion(in south asia and Buddhism)” and “find the boundary condition for 无明”; on 11 October: “yes let's do 无明”. B1 (enough) and B2 (expansion or exhaustion) of the 无明 boundary plan are stated here; B3 (feedback) and B4 (明) are the theorems of P49, P53 and P55 read for seeking, not restated; B5 (hijacking) is not stated. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): 无明 is the not-seeing that keeps seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest, and its boundary is B1; 明 is registration reaching what support does not mark; 知足 and 知止 are targets within the boundary; dominance as such is not the target ruled out. See §83 of the integration note.
